name: hyprwrlds
author: agf
description: World picker (A B C ...) plus the numbered workspaces of the current world. World A = workspaces 1-10, B = 11-20, C = 21-30, and so on. Keys and logic live in ~/.config/hypr/hyprwrlds.lua; this widget calls it with `hyprctl eval 'hyprwrlds.world(N)'`. Replaces omarchy.workspaces in the bar.

barWidget.description: World picker + workspaces of the current world

schema.label: Worlds always shown
schema.description: Letters always shown in the picker. Higher worlds appear automatically while they hold windows or are focused (up to I).

schema.label: Cell width
schema.description: Width of each world letter and workspace number in the bar (Style.space units). 15 = the compact look; 20 = the original wider one.
